packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates together and auto-merge

Anything that RUNS the build: the Gradle wrapper and every Gradle plugin, in ONE group. Two rules share a groupName because Renovate ANDs match types within a rule, so manager and depType cannot be expressed as an OR in a single rule. They are grouped together because they are COUPLED. Shipping them separately guarantees one is red: shadow 9.6.1 needs a newer Gradle than the wrapper provides, so a standalone shadow PR cannot go green until a standalone wrapper PR merges first. Together they build clean, measured locally at Gradle 9.7.1 with shadow 9.6.1. What must stay separate is build-system from LIBRARIES. That is the failure this config exists for: the wrapper errors inside Renovate's container, and while it shared a branch with the libraries it killed the whole grouped batch for nine months. Splitting build-system further, into wrapper versus plugins, was over-separation and broke the coupling above.
The plugin half of the build system group above; same groupName so both land in one PR.
